# Level

> XP and levels saved in the profile.

- Package: `Level` · Category: Progression & live ops
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Level")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Level`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/LevelSystem.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Level = GaxiaServer.Level
```

### Functions

- `Level.SetCurve(fn: (level: number) -> number): ()`
- `Level.GetCurve(): (level: number) -> number`
- `Level.GetLevel(player: Player): number`
- `Level.GetXP(player: Player): number`
- `Level.GetXPToNext(player: Player): number`
- `Level.AddXP(player: Player, amount: number): ()`
- `Level.SetLevel(player: Player, level: number): ()`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Level.OnXPGained` — `Signal<Player, number, number>`
  (player, amount, newTotal) after AddXP adds XP (newTotal before any level-up carry)
- `Level.OnLevelUp` — `Signal<Player, number, number>`
  (player, newLevel, oldLevel) per level gained in AddXP, or when SetLevel changes it
